title: Dazzling Dennis, Near Nash and the LAKE!
description:
Celebrate life! This stylish home is on the edge of everything Nashville and near beautiful Old Hickory Lake.  We are a short $15-20 Uber ride to historic 2nd Ave, Bridgestone Arena, Nissan Stadium and the Country Music Hall of Fame.  Boat rentals and lakeside dining are minutes from 121 Dennis Road in Hendersonville, the city by the lake.  We are the perfect space for exploring Nashville, enjoying the beauty and activities on the water or staying in for R&R.  Fast Wi-Fi throughout the home.

The space
Upon entering Dazzling Dennis you will find a fully equipped kitchen, cozy living rooms with Roku televisions, full bathroom, a bedroom with a queen size bed and a master suite with a king size bed, and walk in shower on the main floor.  A couple of steps down into the bonus room there is a large space for enjoying television, board games, fooze ball table and an  arcade style Miss Pac Man game.  The  stocked laundry room and a mud room with corn hole and other outdoor games are also available for your use.  

Upstairs (12 stairs) there is a full size bathroom that sits in the middle of two bedrooms; one large bedroom with a queen bed and a second kid friendly bedroom with 2 sets of bunk beds sleeping 4 comfortably on twin XL size mattresses.  

Outdoors you will find a large dining table that seats 10 and a semi-enclosed hot tub deck that offers a recessed hot tub providing easy entry and enjoyable conversation style gathering on the deck. Just steps away there is a fire ring complete with roasting sticks and fixings for s’mores.

Guest access
Dazzling Dennis is completely yours for the time period you are renting.  There is ample parking for a boat or other large vehicles that is off road.  We ask that you do not park on the grass.  There is a large oversized concrete driveway for plenty of off street parking.  Garage parking can be arranged for an additional fee.

Other things to note
We offer experiences!  
It is truly a joy to help others celebrate life.  During the time that I have been honored to get to be an Airbnb host I have learned that most folks are celebrating something when they travel.  Good for you!  Usually it is an anniversary, a birthday, a wedding, and sometimes it’s a celebration of life.  I am available to provide experiences which will help you to celebrate well.  My assistance can be as elaborate or as simple as your needs.  It is only limited by your creativity.  Experiences our guests have enjoyed with us: 

Homemade meals prepared in your kitchen or brought to your door.  We can also provide a homecooked meal upon your arrival. 

Interior and/or exterior house decorations for birthdays, bachelorette/bachelor parties, anniversaries or other special events.  This may include fresh flowers, guest appearances, or singing messengers.  We have had the sign genies and live musicians most recently.  This is Nashville you know.  : ) 

Customized shopping to provide wrapped gifts available upon your arrival.  

Grocery delivery stored in the kitchen ready for your use upon your arrival.  

Bouncy houses, boat rentals, and Nashville excursions can all be a part of your adventure.  

Just let me know and we can talk about ideas and the fees associated with your plans.  Happy brainstorming!
